title: Cache freshness uses SystemTime::now() while validator uses now_unix
description: pkix-revocation-http/src/cache.rs lines 661 and 846 use SystemTime::now() inside .filter(|e| is_live(e.next_update, SystemTime::now())) while the validator uses a caller-supplied now_unix. The cache and validator can disagree on whether a CRL/OCSP response is fresh. Old ID: PKIX-f1j4.1
